tools.name: get_sample_spending_analysis

tools.name: get_cash_flow_sankey

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cash_flow_sankey, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cash_flow_sankey, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Public sink: get_blog_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
